full_name: Derron O. Wallace | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2024–2025 Social Sciences Frances B. Cashin Fellow Brandeis University
bio: Derron O. Wallace is a cultural sociologist who specializes in cross-national studies of race, ethnicity, and education, focusing specifically on the experiences of Black youth.
